test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Aquaintance**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **correct spelling **and **meaning **of the **word**.

 
 
• Acquaintance: a person one knows slightly, but who is not a close friend.

 
 
• ​**Example**: *Sania said," I don't know Mr. Vijay personally, he is more of an **acquaintance **__to me."*
 
 
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words.

 
 
• ​**Treacherous: **guilty of or involving betrayal or deception.
 
• **Serendipity: **the occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.
 
• **Malicious: **characterized by malice; intending or intended to do harm.
 
 
 
• ​All the other words are** spelled** correctly.
